boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Academy ceremonies, customs, and recurring regimental practices.

cards.title: Orientation Opening Ceremony
cards.subtitle: The formal start of cadet-candidate orientation
cards.notes: If you are arriving as a new cadet candidate, look for the Athletic Stadium opening ceremony that officially begins Orientation.
cards.short_summary: New cadet candidates begin Orientation together at an Academy opening ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy directs incoming students to report to the Athletic Stadium for the Opening Ceremony, after which Orientation officially begins.
cards.source_title: Orientation - Student Services | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: This is an Orientation event for incoming cadet candidates and their families; follow current Academy instructions.

cards.title: Taking the Orientation Oath
cards.subtitle: A Day 1 cadre and youngie ritual
cards.notes: Notice the Day 1 oath as a visible marker of the incoming class beginning its shared regimental training experience.
cards.short_summary: Orientation accounts document cadre taking an oath before youngies begin their first day.
cards.evidence_claim: An official 2nd Company Orientation account says cadre took an oath before the youngies began learning to march and move together.
cards.access_notes: Part of Academy Orientation training; it is not a public drop-in activity.

cards.title: The Orientation Mini Cruise
cards.subtitle: Buzzards Bay to New York City and back
cards.notes: Follow the Academy’s published route: depart Buzzards Bay, transit Long Island Sound and the East River, then return to campus.
cards.short_summary: The incoming class’s Orientation includes a multi-day training voyage on the Patriot State.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy lists an Orientation Mini Cruise and describes its route from Buzzards Bay through Long Island Sound to New York City and back.
cards.source_title: Orientation - Student Services | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Orientation for cadet candidates; dates and route are subject to Academy updates.

cards.title: Orientation Graduation
cards.subtitle: The close of the initial training cycle
cards.notes: Treat this ceremony as the scheduled endpoint of the intensive Orientation period before freshmen receive their first liberty period.
cards.short_summary: Orientation concludes with an Academy graduation ceremony for the incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy’s Orientation schedule includes an Orientation Graduation Ceremony following the two-week program.
cards.source_title: Orientation - Student Services | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: A scheduled Orientation event; timing is set by the Academy and may change.

cards.title: Cadet Recognition Ceremony
cards.subtitle: When candidates become recognized cadets
cards.notes: Watch for the ceremony marking the end of phase two, when candidates have demonstrated the proficiency required for recognition.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony recognizes candidates as cadets after they complete a training phase.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy states that its Recognition Ceremony celebrates completion of phase two and officially recognizes proficient candidates as cadets.
cards.source_title: Orientation - Student Services | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for cadet candidates during the fall training cycle; consult the Academy for current timing.

cards.title: Standing Watch
cards.subtitle: Training-ship and Cadet Information Center watch
cards.notes: Learn why watch is central to Academy life: licensed majors stand watch aboard ship while other majors staff the Cadet Information Center.
cards.short_summary: Watch duty connects the Academy’s regiment to the professional routines cadets are preparing for.
cards.evidence_claim: An official Orientation report says licensed majors stand watch on the training ship and other majors stand watch at the Cadet Information Center.
cards.source_title: Orientation Day 7 – August 23 | Massachusetts Maritime Academy Orientation
cards.access_notes: Watch assignments and training requirements are managed through the Regiment.

cards.title: Wearing the Uniform with Pride
cards.subtitle: An Academy tradition of solidarity
cards.notes: Read the uniform guidance before a ceremony or formation; the Academy frames proper uniform wear as a shared tradition of solidarity.
cards.short_summary: Uniform wear is explicitly described by the Academy as a solidarity tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy’s uniform page says uniforms are worn with pride and represent an Academy tradition of solidarity.
cards.access_notes: Regimental cadets should follow current Academy uniform guidance and event-specific requirements.

cards.title: Regimental Field & Concert Band
cards.subtitle: Ceremonial music and twice-yearly concerts
cards.notes: Catch the field band at Academy ceremonies or attend one of its biannual concerts to see a longstanding cadet music tradition in action.
cards.short_summary: Cadet musicians provide ceremonial music and perform concert programs during the year.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy identifies Band, Honor Guard, and Drill Team among its three oldest traditions, and says the Ceremonial Field Band performs at Academy events.
cards.source_title: Band, Drill, + Honor Guard | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Participation is through the Academy music program; performance schedules vary.

cards.entity_name: First Watch Jazz & Contemporary Music Ensemble
cards.title: First Watch
cards.subtitle: The Academy’s 1942 big-band tradition
cards.notes: Look for a First Watch performance to hear the cadet ensemble that continues the Academy’s big-band and dance-band tradition.
cards.short_summary: First Watch carries a cadet big-band lineage dating to 1942.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says First Watch was formed in 1942 and continues its jazz big-band and dance-band traditions.
cards.source_title: Band, Drill, + Honor Guard | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Ensemble participation and performances are arranged through the Academy music program.

cards.title: “Onward to Victory”
cards.subtitle: The Academy’s unofficial fight song
cards.notes: Listen for “Onward to Victory” at a band appearance; its music was commissioned for lyrics written by alumnus Jake Daly ’16.
cards.short_summary: A cadet-written song serves as the Academy’s unofficial fight song.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy identifies “Onward to Victory,” with words by Jake Daly ’16 and commissioned music in 2012, as its unofficial fight song.
cards.source_title: Band, Drill, + Honor Guard | Massachusetts Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Look to official Academy band and event programming for current performances.
